say:2:1231153001:0.text: Oh, then I'm mistaken. Sorry for my rudeness.
say:2:1231153001:0.source_cn: 啊，那是我认错了，失礼了。

say:3:1231153002:0.text: Of course, a guest so young would never be able to afford a room like that!
say:3:1231153002:0.source_cn: 我就说，能住进高级套间的客人怎么可能这么年轻！
say:3:1231153002:0.male: Of course, a guest so young would never be able to afford a room like that!
say:3:1231153002:0.female: Of course, a guest so young would never be able to afford a room like that!

say:4:1231153003:0.text: But the guest I saw was indeed quite young and unfamiliar to me.
say:4:1231153003:0.source_cn: 可我记得那位客人确实很年轻，是个生面孔。
say:4:1231153003:0.male: But the guest I saw was indeed quite young and unfamiliar to me.
say:4:1231153003:0.female: But the guest I saw was indeed quite young and unfamiliar to me.

say:5:1231153004:0.text: Could my mind be playing tricks on me?
say:5:1231153004:0.source_cn: 难道真的是我记错了吗？
